duration.text: The Internet of Things Engineering at Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 9722 USD/per year ￥ 70000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 2.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 3.High school academic transcript 4.High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 5.English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. 6.The Transcripts of mathematics, physics, chemistry 7.Health certificate

requirements.text: 1.Aged 18 to 30 years old; 2.A good command of English 3.Analogous to graduating from senior High school in China, with good marks 4.Additional explanation: Applicants, who do not meet the above requirements, may be considered on an individual basis. They may be admitted as non-degree seeking students for one academic year. Those who pass the examinations held one year later will be automatically accepted as regular students. Those who fail will return to their home country as graduate students after completing some courses in a program.
